items.title: McDonald's Moves on Makeover; Dick's Sporting Goods Up on Earnings | Stock Movers
items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Anthropic (ANT) shares are lower and briefly traded below their $83 initial public offering price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab's record-setting debut. 
- McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's betting big on a makeover to win back customers. The chain is tearing down kitchen walls, adding hand-breaded chicken and trendy drinks, plus testing AI to take drive-thru orders. However, the nearly $800-thousand price tag per restaurant has franchisees pushing back and convincing them of the overhaul is becoming a big challenge for the fast food giant.
- Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) shares are climbing after the retailer's third-quarter results easily topped Street expectations. Management also boosted its adjusted EPS forecast for the full year, as well as the low end of its Dick's stores comparable sales target.
